title: Polish Land Parcel Information System (LPIS) dataset @PSNC

description.en: Polish Land Parcel Information System (LPIS) data (land parcel and cadastral data), including all the voivodeships. The input data was in the form of geospatial data in shapefile format.

sparql.title: SPARQL Endpoint in Virtuoso
sparql.description: The dataset can be queried using SPARQL queries from this endpoint.
